FI313-01.meaning: A 400 ms gap can have 200 contiguous nominal 1 ms intervals and 0.2 ms of buffered receipt spacing. No number gap or latch trip distinguishes it from a passing interval.

FI313-02.meaning: A regression aborting AUTO exactly at hb-stall can satisfy a two-second observation anchored to SIGSTOP. The actual expiry must be witnessed and anchor the post-window.

FI313-03.meaning: The last TRUE of the whole section is after recovery of the heartbeat, not the expiry. Recovery of the latch also needs an integrity-covered section after the pre-acknowledgement section closes.
